name: Privileged Entitlement Recommendation Available for Review
description: Sent to the entitlement or source owner to notify them that a privileged entitlement recommendation is available for their review.
subject: Privileged Entitlement Recommendation Ready for Review
body:
Privileged Entitlement Recommendation Ready for Review

Dear $__recipient.name,

A privileged entitlement recommendation is available for your review.

Entitlement: ${EntitlementName}

Review this recommendation on the Privileged Entitlement Recommendations page.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
